what_works: High contrast black text on a near-white background ensures excellent readability and visual clarity.
Strategic use of white space creates a calm, uncluttered layout that guides the eye naturally through the content.
Distinctive button styling with a solid black 'Sign up' pill and an outlined 'Book a demo' creates clear visual hierarchy for actions.
Large, abstract circular imagery in the central section adds visual interest without overwhelming the minimalist aesthetic.
Clear typographic hierarchy using varied font weights and sizes to differentiate headlines, subheads, and body text.
